correctness.rationale: The monoid is exactly the flip-equivariant transformation monoid, and regularity is equivalent to every fixed point in the image having a fixed preimage. Independent diagonal/off-diagonal sampling gives the exact count. A uniform span-one tilted-Poisson local CLT gives the correct occupancy prefactor; the off-diagonal factor contributes exp((1-x^2)/4); F is strictly concave with one saddle, and endpoint coefficient bounds permit discrete Laplace summation and the conditional CLT. Finite exact enumeration n<=3, direct monoid inner-inverse enumeration at n=2, and numerical probability/conditional-variance ratios through 640 pass; they supplement rather than establish the infinite proof.
